review_scope: Manual reading of the full source paragraphs; exact quotations verified automatically against preserved semantic article text. Secondary textual evidence only.

claims.label: Licker β / Licker beta
claims.excerpt: Just like its forbear back in Raccoon City, the Licker beta clings to walls and ceilings, and attacks its enemies with its long tongue and sharp claws.
claims.limitation: La même page intitule ce sujet «Licker β» et emploie «Licker beta»; ne vaut pas une nomenclature officielle.

claims.label: Shooter Ooze
claims.excerpt: The Tricorne Ooze (or Shooter Ooze as it is commonly aliased) is a variant of the regular Ooze.
claims.limitation: Alias explicitement attribué par cette source secondaire, dans Revelations uniquement.

claims.label: Exploding Ooze
claims.excerpt: The Chunk Ooze (or Exploding Ooze) is another variant of the regular Ooze.
claims.limitation: Alias explicitement attribué par cette source secondaire, dans Revelations uniquement.

claims.label: Parasitage par Nemesis
claims.excerpt: He is capable of grabbing these enemies and injecting their heads with one of his parasites.
claims.limitation: Action attribuée à Nemesis dans le texte expliquant la création de l’hôte; ce n’est pas une commande de l’hôte NE-α.

claims.label: Tentacules et protection crânienne
claims.excerpt: The result is a much more powerful creature with whipping tentacles capable of reaching you from a fair distance, and their head is now shielded by the parasite's husk making it harder to take down these new foes.
claims.limitation: L’hôte n’est pas une Plaga Cephalo. La citation ne chiffre ni portée ni cadence.

claims.label: Vitesse et morsures de Forest
claims.excerpt: He will behave similar to an ordinary Zombie, however he will move much faster and his bites are more damaging.
claims.limitation: Pas de vitesse mesurée ni de timing d’animation fourni.

claims.label: Variante One Dangerous Zombie
claims.excerpt: When replaying the game with "One Dangerous Zombie" mode unlocked, Forest will appear in other areas of the mansion instead but with one noticeable difference. His body will be strapped with grenades, and you'll know it is him inside a room before seeing him as he'll give off a distinctive clinking noise as he moves around.
claims.limitation: Variante de mode explicite; ne pas appliquer ses grenades au Forest ordinaire.

claims.label: Escalade murs et plafonds
claims.excerpt: They are capable of climbing on walls and ceilings using their immensely large and powerful claws.
claims.limitation: RE2 remake uniquement. Aucun cycle, durée ou changement de surface fourni.

claims.label: Cécité et ouïe sensible
claims.excerpt: Their weakness is their inability to see, however their hearing has developed to be incredibly sensitive.
claims.limitation: La cécité est une faiblesse sensorielle; ne pas en faire une zone corporelle à dégâts bonus.

claims.label: Langue, déplacement et surfaces
claims.excerpt: The name comes from its incredibly long tongue, and it can use this to whip at you from a distance while it crawls around on all fours on the floor, walls and ceiling to avoid your bullets.
claims.limitation: RE2 original uniquement; pas de timing ni portée métrique certifiée.

claims.label: Cécité dans RE2 original
claims.excerpt: These enemies to have one weakness, and that is they are blind.
claims.limitation: Citation conservée avec sa faute originale; RE2 original, pas de fusion avec le remake.

claims.label: Feu
claims.excerpt: As with all plant-based creatures, their primary weakness is fire.
claims.limitation: La généralisation appartient à l’auteur; la preuve ici reste liée à Ivy de RE2 remake.

claims.label: Attaque mortelle de proximité
claims.excerpt: The result is essentially a zombie with plant-like appendages, and is extremely lethal on close proximity, sometimes resulting in an instant-death attack.
claims.limitation: Aucun montage de finisher généré depuis cette phrase; contexte de rencontre seulement.

claims.label: Langue, griffes et surfaces
claims.excerpt: Just like its forbear back in Raccoon City, the Licker beta clings to walls and ceilings, and attacks its enemies with its long tongue and sharp claws.
claims.limitation: Licker β de RE5; pas de copie des timings des Lickers des autres jeux.

claims.label: Mauvaise vue, ouïe et odorat
claims.excerpt: The final product was still considered unsatisfactory, as the new Licker still has extremely poor eyesight, compensated only with the sensitive senses of hearing and smell.
claims.limitation: Mauvaise vue n’est pas une mesure de cécité totale; aucune valeur sensorielle inventée.

claims.label: Noyau orange intermittent
claims.excerpt: Its weak point is an orange core that sometimes reveals itself on its arm-like portion.
claims.limitation: Uroboros de la première rencontre RE5; pas de transfert automatique aux autres formes.

claims.label: Passage par petits espaces
claims.excerpt: Its tentacle-like protrusions constantly gather and disburse, allowing it to easily squirm through small spaces.
claims.limitation: Aucune géométrie de collision ni dimension d’ouverture inférée.

claims.label: Saut annoncé de 20 mètres
claims.excerpt: Leon's former comrade, Jack Krauser, has armed himself with superhuman powers, allowing him to move at lightning speed and leap 20 metres into the air.
claims.limitation: La hauteur de saut est une affirmation secondaire de mouvement, JAMAIS la taille de son corps. Non corroborée par mesure.

claims.label: Mutation du bras gauche
claims.excerpt: During the main confrontation with him at the sand fortress, you see the full extent of his powers as he mutates his left arm into a wing-like weapon, capable of deflecting bullets.
claims.limitation: Bras GAUCHE explicitement indiqué; pas de miroir, pas de mutation anticipée aux phases humaines.
claims.source_phase: Mutated left arm at the sand fortress in RE4 original

claims.label: Vitesse de la forme humaine
claims.excerpt: His superhuman abilities and his lightning speed meant he could not be fought in a traditional way, as it is almost impossible to fire a gun at him and land a successful hit.
claims.limitation: La source redirige /albert-wesker-enemy vers /albert-wesker. Cette page ne prouve pas les gestes de la mutation Uroboros.

claims.label: Griffe à courte distance
claims.excerpt: If you get within a certain distance, he will start swiping his claw at you, which can hurt a lot.
claims.limitation: RE1 original; la source distingue laboratoire et héliport, sans fournir les animations ni les durées.

claims.label: Griffe à courte distance
claims.excerpt: If you get within a certain distance, he will start swiping his claw at you, which can hurt a lot.
claims.limitation: RE1 remake; aucun emprunt au modèle ou timing de RE1 original.

claims.label: Cœur exposé non décrit comme vulnérable
claims.excerpt: Its heart is located outside its body on its chest, however this still doesn't make it vulnerable for attack or weakness.
claims.limitation: NÉGATION préservée: la source ne valide pas le cœur comme point faible; aucune règle de collision changée.

claims.label: Cœur exposé non décrit comme vulnérable
claims.excerpt: Its heart is located outside its body on its chest, however this still doesn't make it vulnerable for attack or weakness.
claims.limitation: NÉGATION préservée: la source ne valide pas le cœur comme point faible; aucune règle de collision changée.

claims.label: Longueur maximale annoncée, pinces comprises
claims.excerpt: It reaches lengths of up to three meters, including its pincers.
claims.limitation: Affirmation secondaire, maximum de longueur totale avec pinces; ni hauteur, ni longueur du seul tronc, ni mesure indépendante.

claims.label: Pinces capables de couper l’acier
claims.excerpt: Its pincers in particular are tough enough to cut through steel.
claims.limitation: Description secondaire de capacité; aucun dégât ou effet d’acier simulé déduit.

claims.label: Tête vulnérable
claims.excerpt: The Stinger has a tough, armoured body, but its head is surprisingly vulnerable.
claims.limitation: Tête et carapace distinguées; pas de multiplicateur de dégâts inventé.

claims.label: Lumière du soleil, seconde forme
claims.excerpt: However it does have a very strong weakness to sunlight...
claims.limitation: Seconde forme uniquement; la phrase ne définit pas une lampe générique ni un seuil UV.

claims.label: Passage dans grilles et conduits
claims.excerpt: Ooze dynamically change the structure of their bodies, which allows them to hide in vents, creep through floor grates, and surprise agents with attacks from unsuspecting places.
claims.limitation: Pas de modèle déformable, rig, collision ni durée produits depuis la citation.

claims.label: Tête
claims.excerpt: Their weak point is their head.
claims.limitation: Ooze ordinaire de Revelations uniquement; aucune valeur de dégâts fournie.

claims.label: Projectiles osseux
claims.excerpt: They prefer to fight from long range and have a sharp gun-like appendage that shoots spinning bone projectiles at the player.
claims.limitation: Projectile décrit, sans cadence, vitesse, hitbox ni portée chiffrée.

claims.label: Tête
claims.excerpt: As with the regular Oozes, their weak spot is also their head.
claims.limitation: Tricorne Ooze, pas tous les ennemis de Revelations.

claims.label: Tête
claims.excerpt: As with the regular Oozes, their weak spot is also their head.
claims.limitation: Pincer Ooze, pas un transfert de dimensions ou d’animations depuis l’Ooze ordinaire.

claims.label: Explosion suicidaire à proximité
claims.excerpt: Their method of attack is unique in that they will sacrifice themselves and explode when you get too close.
claims.limitation: Le seuil de proximité et le délai restent inconnus.

claims.label: Corps explosif
claims.excerpt: Their weak spot is their massive bulk of a body, but stand clear when you fire as they will explode.
claims.limitation: Faiblesse corporelle avec explosion; ne pas omettre la conséquence.

claims.label: Engloutissement aquatique
claims.excerpt: Be sure to avoid them completely when they are in water, as they are capable of swallowing you whole.
claims.limitation: Action explicitement aquatique; ne pas la généraliser aux apparitions terrestres.

claims.label: Bouche ventrale
claims.excerpt: Their weak spot is their mouth on the underside of their body.
claims.limitation: La face inférieure n’est pas visible dans tous les portraits; aucun point anatomique masqué inventé.

claims.label: Cage thoracique latérale
claims.excerpt: Their weak spot is their exposed ribcage on the side of their bodies.
claims.limitation: Revelations seulement; côté gauche/droit non spécifié par cette phrase.
